snippet.title: Red Zero Visual Novel -  Short Trailer
snippet.description:
Download Red Zero for FREE at https://novaswarm-vt3.itch.io/red-zero

Help navigate a sleep deprived student through USC where danger, exams and the soul crushing weight of simply being a university student are around every corner.  Oh, and there's zombies.

Video + Graphics by Nova SWARM - https://novaswarm.carrd.co
Music by October - https://twitter.com/october_stereo
